#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# The backup destination is supplied by the environment so this repo does not
# have to hard-code host-specific storage. It can be a local mount path
# (/mnt/backups) or a remote host path (user@host:/path/to/backups).
DEST="${DEST:-}"

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "DEST is not set (expected a local path or host:path)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
    *)
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"

arguments.command: sh -n backup.sh && tmp=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$tmp/logs" "$tmp/dest" && echo 'test log line' > "$tmp/logs/app.log" && cp backup.sh "$tmp/backup.sh" && (cd "$tmp" && DEST="$tmp/dest" sh backup.sh) && find "$tmp" -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort && rm -rf "$tmp"
